newsitem.title: GREECE: Higher Greek volume needed to top 1,600 - chartist.
newsitem.headline: Higher Greek volume needed to top 1,600 - chartist.

text.p: Trading volume in the Athens bourse has to rise substantially for the index to top 1,600 points in the near-term, said Commercial Securities in a technical analysis report.
"The absence of strong transaction volume renders immediate clearing of the 1,600 fairly difficult," said Commercial's chart analyst Nick Kostopoulos.
"The most likely scenario over coming sessions suggests that the index will continue hovering around 1,550 points until prices consolidate and volume picks up," the report said.
Kostopoulos said 1,550 points was a support level which would serve as a springboard for higher levels to be attained within the coming two months.

"The 1,550-point area should be treated as a support level after it was penetrated upwards," it said. "Technical indicators show the market has recorded a short-term low and is headed up on a two-month horizon."

The breakout above 1,600 points was seen as a sure bet, but its timing depended on whether shares would trade narrowly between 1,550-1,600 points in the near-term or would slide to 1,500 points in light trade. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
